thought
AHA!! Look at that!
The interviewee is a strict closed-world simulator whose prompt ONLY contains domain facts / business rules, and says "I don't know" whenever asked anything not in its fact sheet (or maybe it DOES have facts about some of those topics if phrased around its fact sheet, or maybe it literally only knows domain facts about fleet, charging pads, repairs, charging, retiring, sites, dispatchers!).
Let's carefully explore every single thing mentioned so far!
In Q3:
- add new drones to the fleet
- retire old ones
- set up charging pads at our sites
- take drones out of service for repairs and put them back
- send drones to charge
In Q13:
- few hundred drones of several models from different manufacturers
- differ in load capacity, how far they can fly on a full battery, sensors, charging connectors (not interchangeable)
- each drone has a home site
- few dozen charging pads at our sites, never lent to another company

Let's ask open questions about each of these areas to uncover all the facts in their knowledge base! First, let's ask about charging pads and sending drones to charge.What can you tell me about how sending drones to charge works, including any rules or problems around charging pads?
